title: Austin's New Budget Proposal Revealed
summary:
*   The City Manager formally presented their proposed budget for the upcoming fiscal year.
*   This presentation marks the official start of the city's annual budget review process.
*   No immediate votes, policy decisions, or actions were taken on the budget plan at this initial meeting.
transcript:
